note: Campground on a Small Lake.  16 is the only waterfront site, but other sites may have a partial view of the lake.  --AWH  GA DNR state park built around a large natural spring (7M gal/day) with a small lake; site of Civil War Camp Lawton. Fishing dock, boardwalk. Oct 2026: the lake is closed to boats and rentals for extremely low water. --Claude
summary: Booking engine still gastateparks.reserveamerica.com (parkId 530179; deep link added as booking.url). Catalog: 24 public sites (26 less 2 hosts), 30/50 A + water, sewer only at the hosts, 25-40 ft so all fit 23 ft, 6 pull-throughs; $34 / $38 the same on Sat 2026-11-14 and Tue 2027-06-15 (stored 34-38 confirmed; the fees note's 'full hookups $38' was wrong - the $38 tier is the pull-throughs plus site 16). Electric 50, water, count 26 -> 24, max 40, pull-through, laundry added. Note: dropped counts/'reservable via ReserveAmerica', added the dated low-water lake closure from the park page; AWH text kept verbatim. Pin ~90 m from the per-site centroid (32.88314,-81.95208) - fine. Season (year-round) and military discount left.
flags: Phone: stored 1-800-864-7275 is the statewide reservations line. The park page gives 'Park 478-982-1660' (also on the booking site's alerts). Suggest 478-982-1660.

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored lakefront rests on site 16 alone (AWH: '16 is the only waterfront site'). The booking site tags only site 16 'Proximity to Water: Y' (priced $38 though a back-in). On Esri imagery its pad (GIS 32.88354,-81.95303) sits ~40-45 m from the lake's east shore behind a continuous band of pine canopy, with no open apron to the water. Every other pad is farther. Firsthand AWH note, so not changed - but lakefront for the campground as a whole needs the gate's look.

Park page alert (2026-10-29): 'Our lake is currently closed to rentals and personal vessels (boats, kayaks, canoes, etc.) due to extremely low water levels.' Campground open; recorded as a dated note line, not a status.
